narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the repo structure.
finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Of 380 commits, 37 touch users.

Four are breaking and nobody labeled them. Error types stopped being re-exported from five modules. The v1 export route is gone. Expired tokens now return 401, not 403. The latency histogram units changed, so dashboards need rescaling.

One feature: webhook retries with backoff.

Two guesses to check. I read `tighten the token parser error message` as no longer echoing the token. The `docs: note the minimum node version` and `ci: run the suite on node 22` commits may mean an `engines` bump. Nothing in the log confirms it, so I left it out.

I also dropped 9 `perf` commits. Your three headings have no home for them.

Next: confirm those two, then set the release date if it is not 2026-08-30.
